gate_b_requirements.promotion: No historical result authorizes purchase, production, betting, or promotion. Any apparent positive region requires separate strict independent EV review and validation.

metrics_frozen_for_gate_b: complete-issue hit rate and ticket coverage
mean/P50/P90/P95/max issue stake; total stake and capital utilization

outcome_boundary: No test outcome, score, final/winning SP, settlement, payout, ROI, tax realization, or post-kickoff input is read or emitted.

sampling_contract.full_control: M=2187 is FULL_ENUMERATED exactly once per issue; it is not a with-replacement draw
